title: Appointment Series Status: Activation, Pauses, Completion and Cancellation
content:
Terms of the appointment agreement on the statuses an Appointment Series passes through.

**Statuses.** A series is booked, active, paused, completed or cancelled.

- **Booked to active.** A series becomes active at its first attended appointment.
- **Active to paused.** An active series may be paused — for example funding on hold, patient travel or illness, or surgery — at most the format's number of pauses per series; its standing slots are suspended.
- **Paused to active.** A paused series resumes on the same standing slots.
- **Active to completed.** A series completes when its booked visits are used up after its last appointment or its end date has passed.
- **Cancelled.** A series is cancelled when the patient asks, when appointments were released after missed visits, or when its funding ends without a replacement. A booked series may be cancelled before its first visit; an active or a paused series may also be cancelled.

**Pause expiry.** A paused series is cancelled for pause expiry no earlier than the format's maximum pause period in calendar days after the pause start date on file. Days are counted as calendar days from the pause start date, the pause start date itself being day zero; the cancellation may take place on the last day itself.

**Standing slot.** Where the format holds a standing slot, the weekday and time pattern is held for the whole series and released only by cancellation.

**Boundary cases (hypothetical, 30-day pause period).** Pause start date on 1 June (day zero): a cancellation for pause expiry may be made on 1 July (day 30) or later; on 30 June (day 29) it may not.

**Pause count (hypothetical).** On a format allowing 2 pauses per series, a series that has already been paused twice is not paused a third time.
